asset_set: Questionnaire Q4 option 2 — Researching AI ethics

art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade
art_style.mood: thoughtful conceptual-research energy — approachable ethics-and-tech reflection, not a sci-fi control room
forbidden: robot faces or humanoid AI figures

riasec_secondary.use: connecting lines between nodes, glasses frame accent

color.background: transparent — faint grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, thin round glasses frame, calm expression, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — distinct hairstyle, skin tone, glasses accessory, and outfit from prior slots

pose.stance: full body, standing beside a small standing corkboard or easel prop
pose.action: holding a printed page showing an abstract node diagram in one hand, annotating beside a circled node with a fountain pen in the other

top.detail: charcoal shirt sleeves, teal collar piping

subject.scene_narrative: A thoughtful young man stands beside a small standing easel, studying a printed page showing an abstract neural-network node diagram and annotating beside one highlighted decision node with a fountain pen — a full-body flat vector figure capturing the quiet, deliberate pace of ethical and conceptual research.
subject.hero_prop: printed diagram page showing an abstract network of violet node circles linked by teal connecting lines, one node circled by hand
supporting_props: fountain pen with violet cap band
small tablet propped on easel mirroring the same diagram faintly
small ceramic mug resting at easel base
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey decorative circles behind figure — no lab or control room interior

composition.layout: figure left-of-center, easel with diagram right, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + diagram page readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter I, readable paragraphs, robot face, humanoid AI, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background.
